name: Ivanti
description: Connect your own Ivanti Service Manager (ISM) / Neurons for ITSM tenant to manage Incidents, Service Requests, Problems, Changes, Configuration Items, and Knowledge Articles through the OData Business Object API, plus a generic BO passthrough.

tools.name: connect_ivanti
tools.description: Connect an Ivanti Service Manager (ISM) tenant via OAuth2 or Basic Auth, after validating connectivity.

host.description: Ivanti ISM tenant host, e.g. 'https://acme.ivanticloud.com' (cloud) or 'https://host' (on-prem).
host.title: Host

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode: 'oauth2' (Ivanti Identity Broker, cloud) or 'basic' (service account, on-prem/legacy).
auth_mode.title: Auth Mode

username.description: Service account username. Required when auth_mode is 'basic'.
username.title: Username

password.description: Service account password. Required when auth_mode is 'basic'.
password.title: Password

client_id.description: OAuth2 client id. Required when auth_mode is 'oauth2'.
client_id.title: Client Id

client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret. Required when auth_mode is 'oauth2'.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

token_url.description: Optional OAuth2 token URL override. Defaults to '<host>/oauth/token'.
token_url.title: Token Url
